scope: Workflow coverage supplements per-member routing. No new native checks or UI parity are claimed.

workflows.missing: Two raster sources submitted. CineForm preset failed with native code27 despite true Promise; distinct ProRes experiment remains unconfirmed. No Dynamic Link or successful alpha output proof.
Exact outputFiles correlation is implemented; jobID-only progress/error/cancel cannot safely identify a batch input. Promise success is not completion.
No decoder/file-content verification of readability, duration, dimensions, fps or preserved transparency. A .mov extension or preset name is insufficient.
Native Render and Replace, Restore Unrendered and generic menu execution are absent from the audited official DOM. Manual native workflow remains the supported alternative.

Overwrite does not promise clip-state preservation. No documented clip speed/reverse setter or complete interpolation/tangent readback establishes lossless recreation. No verified clip-retention/clone strategy exists yet. Shared-source relinking is not an acceptable substitute.
Exact native event presence/delivery and payload variants need version-specific tests. Encoder scalar payloads and private output-count handling are implemented.
Caption inventory/mute/naming routes do not establish full text authoring.
Object-mask presence queries do not establish mask drawing/tracking endpoints.
Multicam identification does not establish a documented camera-switch operation.
